items.title: AWS starts SageMaker jobs from SOCI-indexed images in seconds
notes: Sources identify October 2026 or say the feature is available today, but do not print the announcement day.

items.title: AWS exposes Step Functions workflows as tools for AI agents
problems: Before: Teams wrote Lambda adapters or MCP servers to expose Step Functions; the sources say these are no longer needed but do not establish what teams previously did or had to do.
Before: Teams encoded business sequences in agents; the sources do not say this was the prior approach.
WhyCare: Step Functions preserves execution history without qualification; the documentation specifies execution history for Standard workflows, not Express workflows.
notes: The announcement source says the capability is available today and its URL identifies October 2026, but neither source prints the announcement day.

items.title: LangChain adds browser use and async subagents to Managed Deep Agents
problems: Before: Teams needed a separate browser service to use JavaScript-driven websites without APIs; the sources describe the new managed browser but do not establish this prior requirement.
notes: The release post says v0.10 is out and in public beta today, but does not print the announcement day.
